queries.post:
SELECT p.post_id, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS group_id, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(p.content,1000,1) AS content,
       DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(p.content) AS text_length
FROM n_posts p JOIN n_users author ON author.user_id=p.author_id AND author.is_active=1
WHERE p.post_id=:target_id AND p.is_deleted=0 AND p.visibility='public'
  AND fn_can_view_post(:actor_id,p.post_id)=1
queries.comment:
SELECT p.post_id, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS group_id, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.content,1000,1) AS content,
       DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(c.content) AS text_length
FROM n_comments c
JOIN n_posts p ON p.post_id=c.post_id AND p.is_deleted=0 AND p.visibility='public'
JOIN n_users author ON author.user_id=c.user_id AND author.is_active=1
JOIN n_users parent_author ON parent_author.user_id=p.author_id AND parent_author.is_active=1
WHERE c.comment_id=:target_id AND c.is_deleted=0 AND fn_can_view_post(:actor_id,p.post_id)=1
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_user_blocks b
    WHERE (b.user_id=:actor_id AND b.target_user_id=c.user_id)
       OR (b.target_user_id=:actor_id AND b.user_id=c.user_id))
queries.group_post:
SELECT p.post_id, g.group_id, SUBSTR(p.content,1,1000) AS content, LENGTH(p.content) AS text_length
FROM n_group_posts p JOIN n_groups g ON g.group_id=p.group_id
JOIN n_users author ON author.user_id=p.author_id AND author.is_active=1
WHERE p.post_id=:target_id AND p.is_deleted=0 AND g.privacy='public' AND g.is_active=1 AND g.is_deleted=0
  AND fn_can_view_group(:actor_id,g.group_id)=1
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_user_blocks b
    WHERE (b.user_id=:actor_id AND b.target_user_id=p.author_id)
       OR (b.target_user_id=:actor_id AND b.user_id=p.author_id))
queries.group_post_comment:
SELECT p.post_id, g.group_id, SUBSTR(c.content,1,1000) AS content, LENGTH(c.content) AS text_length
FROM n_group_comments c
JOIN n_group_posts p ON p.post_id=c.post_id AND p.is_deleted=0
JOIN n_groups g ON g.group_id=p.group_id
JOIN n_users author ON author.user_id=c.author_id AND author.is_active=1
JOIN n_users parent_author ON parent_author.user_id=p.author_id AND parent_author.is_active=1
WHERE c.comment_id=:target_id AND c.is_deleted=0 AND g.privacy='public' AND g.is_active=1 AND g.is_deleted=0
  AND fn_can_view_group(:actor_id,g.group_id)=1
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_user_blocks b
    WHERE (b.user_id=:actor_id AND b.target_user_id IN (c.author_id,p.author_id))
       OR (b.target_user_id=:actor_id AND b.user_id IN (c.author_id,p.author_id)))
